verdict.rationale: Qodo provides configuration-as-code (.pr_agent.toml) and centralized rule systems that can be version-controlled, plus a history of findings/decisions via code governance dashboards, which supports 'versioning' and 'review' of automation config at a basic level. However, there is no explicit evidence of rollback functionality for automations, no versioned history/diff view of rule changes over time, and no dedicated UI for reverting to prior automation states. missing for 10: explicit rollback mechanism for automation/config changes, version history diffing of rules over time, and hands-on confirmation that config-as-code changes can be reverted through the product itself.
